pool.text: The city eventually fell to the Byzantine Empire following the Byzantine conquest.
Sredets was once again incorporated into the restored Bulgarian Empire at this time.
Sredets became an Ottoman possession following its conquest by the Ottoman Empire.
Hungarian forces occupied the city for a short time during the Crusade of Varna.
Sofia became the regional capital of Rumelia Eyalet for about three centuries.
The Vatican established the See of Sofia for Catholics of Rumelia.
An important uprising against Ottoman rule took place in Sofia, Samokov and Western Bulgaria.
Nedelya Petkova created the first Bulgarian school for women in the city.
The first chitalishte, which is a Bulgarian cultural institution, was inaugurated here.
Bulgaria declared war on the US and UK on 13 December.
Sofia and the rest of Bulgaria were occupied by the Soviet Red Army.
The communist Fatherland Front took power in the country.
The transformation of Bulgaria into the People's Republic altered the city's appearance.
The Boyana Church in Sofia was included on the World Heritage List.
Alexander Yanchulev was elected as the first directly elected mayor of Sofia.
The Sofia Metro became operational with only five initial stations.
The Georgi Dimitrov Mausoleum was completely demolished in the city.
Forbes listed Sofia as a top place to launch a startup business.
Vasil Terziev won the mayoral election as the nominee of a coalition.
Vasil Levski Sofia Airport handled millions of passengers during the year.
